newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mob attacks Tutsi property in Zaire's capital.
newsitem.headline: Mob attacks Tutsi property in Zaire's capital.

text.p: A mob of several hundred demonstrators attacked Tutsi-owned property in Zaire's capital Kinshasa on Friday and looted dozens of cars, a Reuters cameraman said.

"I saw them smash the windows of two shops said to be owned by Tutsis in central Kinshasa and loot a beer truck. They were driving around in dozens of stolen cars," said Reuters Television cameraman Marc Hoogsteyns.
